buildProvenance.sourceHashSampling: Current workspace files at recorder launch; compiled snapshot provenance is the root copy proof plus served main/resource hashes.

actualCompiledBuildProfile.qualification: Read from the frozen served bundle. This task checks training-range VFX and actual casts, not campaign growth/balance acceptance. Concurrent profile flags are recorded as compiled and are never changed to force normal-rule claims.

artSourceEvidence.declaration: V37 deterministically adds a faint orange interior fill and adjusts texture translucency. The V35 cloud source/prompt are reused without generation. Texture alpha may change; renderer draw opacity is recorded separately. Calculated material samples and native captures remain separate evidence categories.
artSourceEvidence.processingThisRound: deterministic translucent orange fill and texture alpha adjustment

gameplayComparison.qualification: Same isolated training level and equal recorded event totals.
gameplayComparison.sourceHashQualification: Workspace source hashes sampled at launch are not claimed to prove a compiled rules diff by themselves. The served frozen main/resources and root build/copy provenance identify the actual recording payload.

targetAlignment.qualification: This checks actual event/cue anchors. Native stage images must still establish visible rock, flame and seal alignment.

coolingContinuityEvidence.qualification: Review the actual native images and every transition. Active pool records, mesh counts and eventual clearing do not prove an unbroken visible fire surface.

ignitionPropagationEvidence.samplingQualification: Nearest real exported 30fps frame. Requested ages may share a frame; actual ages remain authoritative. No interpolated frames or timing changes.
ignitionPropagationEvidence.geometryQualification: Explicit supportWidth/supportDepth/footprintRadius describe the fixed carrier; width is a world-bounds measurement and is not substituted for support. Inspector constants alone do not prove visible ignition propagation or art acceptance.

persistentSealEvidence.qualification: Ground meteorSeal records and their actual opacity are checked independently of fire/impact records. Native images still establish visible carving clarity, rear completeness and gradual fading; inspector alpha alone is not art acceptance.

sameFrameColourEvidence.qualification: Each actual native frame contains the central flame and sigil. Compare the faint orange interior fill and visible ground through the more translucent sigil. Texture alpha is intentionally allowed to change; renderer draw opacity is separate. Only fixed cropping/uniform resizing is used, with no exact pixel-colour match claim.

sealFadeTransitions.qualification: Pause intentionally hides and clears active VFX. Cached opacity is the actual last-draw surface property, not a visible paused seal or a newly simulated alpha. The authoritative clock stays frozen; active ground.inspect opacity resumes from that clock.

artStatusNote: Review a faint continuous flame-orange centre fill and more translucent whole sigil, with ground visible through it before impact and beside the central flame. Geometry/timing remain; texture alpha is intentionally allowed to change while renderer opacity remains separately recorded. No new generation or user art acceptance is claimed.

sealReviewEvidence.nativeCropAlteration: Crop only from actual default-camera recording; no colour/effect edits.

sealReviewEvidence.rawResourceAlteration: Exact copied PNG bytes from the served frozen/live build. Diagnostic data only; do not composite arbitrary raw data channels on a dark background as a final material.

materialProvenance.calculatedPreviewDeclaration: Both warning and same-actual-fire-phase panels use the existing camera ellipse and exact two-texture shader formula. Computational candidate only; not new native Cocos evidence.

sealReviewEvidence.colourJudgement: Use actual prewarning native crops. Any separately provided shader-math material sample must be labelled as a calculated sample rather than a runtime image.

sealColourThreeWay.processing: Crop and uniform resize only, with each original perspective preserved. No colour, brightness or effect changes.

sealBeforeColourNativeComparison.processing: Same fixed native crop, uniform resize only. No colour, brightness or perspective changes.

media.nativeVideoAlteration: Original complete canvas frames, recorded order and 9-second timing; no overlays.
media.closeupVideoAlteration: Crop only (0, 0, 1550, 1272), same camera/actors/time; no VFX/text overlays.
media.comparisonImages: Crop/resize/layout only; both v29 original bottom panels retained.

assetStabilityAtDelivery.qualification: Frozen served resource bytes are authoritative for the recording. Current source changes, if any, are reported separately and never relabel the served snapshot.
